schedulers.name: gridengine
schedulers.gpu_assignment: $SGE_HGR_gpu translated to CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES by the generated script

routing.host_alias_note: helix/kinase become all.q plus hostname; beta/serine become all plus nodelist

storage.home: /home/<user> shared NFS for configuration and small scripts
storage.work: /work/<user> shared storage for datasets and large output
